description: This source file provides utility functions for handling ninja build commands related to precompiled headers, including generating filenames for PCH files, writing compiler flags, and managing PCH output files within a build system.

methods.name: GetPCHLangSuffixForToolType
methods.description: Returns the language-specific suffix for precompiled header files based on the tool type.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHFile
methods.description: Computes the filename for the Windows precompiled header (.pch) for a given target and tool.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Writes compiler flags for a target, handling precompiled headers and substitutions.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Generates the output files for precompiled headers based on target and tool.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Returns the GCC-specific extension for precompiled header output files.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Returns the object file extension for Windows PCH files, annotated with language suffix.
